name: Farseer Nobundo
guide_text: You want to copy the same, strong spell over and over. With an early [[Strike Oil||104029]] or [[Chef's Choice||105664]], you can hero power every single turn to start printing Strike Oils. Then, later on you generate a strong spell such as [[Temperature Shift||117670]] every turn.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up when it costs 5-7.The best spell to discover is [[Temperature Shift||117670]]. Your hero power can copy it every turn. Keep the buddy around to sell ever turn with a [[Lantern Lava]]. Even better if you have a [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], this combo just wins the game.
